notes: «إسحاق أخبرنا وقال الآخران» is one group with three co-transmitters.
Salman narrates Umar's words («قال قال عمر بن الخطاب»): Umar is the last link.
Umar's account has the Prophet speaking inside it, and Umar is a Companion speaking in a scene; by rule 11 that narrated encounter is flagged rather than settled.
